reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. At the Eau Claire yard, drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 for the 04:00 shift weren't getting their bay assignments by text. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the problem was gone on 5 Oct.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was sent up to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

Things to know before you paste these in:
- The two numbers are written differently and both involve Door 14, but the notes describe them as separate problems. I listed them separately and didn't assume they're the same ticket.
- The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell you when #4419 was opened or whether it's still open.
- Moss's other notes either mention Quarrendon with no ticket number (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal note) or are about other accounts. Tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central notes belong to Marrow, not Quarrendon.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a Pemberline customer, so I left it out.

I only looked at Moss's notes in the shared files you can open. I didn't check the actual ticket records.
